title: Weatherstation Metric0 Field Completeness Score
dataSources: Weather-station readings (`weatherstation:reading`), daily weather-impact rollups (`personalweather:daily`), sleep correlation records (`personalweather:sleep`), step correlation records (`personalweather:steps`), mood correlation records (`personalweather:mood`).
app: Local weather-station readings correlated with personal sleep, steps, mood, and outdoor-activity summaries in Splunk via scripted inputs and daily rollups.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=weatherstation:metric0
| eval complete=if(isnotnull(value) AND isnotnull(duration_min),1,0)
| stats sum(complete) as complete_rows, count as total
| eval completeness_pct=round(100*complete_rows/total,1)
description: Measures how often weatherstation metric0 events include both value and duration.
value: Incomplete exports break joins and dashboards; completeness scoring catches schema drift early.
implementation: Require `value` and `duration_min` on weatherstation metric0 events and track completeness percentage.
visualization: Single-value gauge of field completeness percent.
grandmaExplanation: It estimates how often your weatherstation metric0 exports arrive with the key numbers filled in.
